After activating your class ability, your next [Stasis] Stasis weapon final blow creates a Stasis Shard. 

Gather Stasis Shards to gain stacks of Crystalline Converter, which cause your next powered Stasis melee hit to create Stasis crystals equal to the number of stacks you have.

Picking up Stasis Shards progresses the Crystalline Converter Counter.
Upon dealing Stasis Melee Damage or Diamond Lance Damage: 
Consumes the Crystalline Converter Counter.
Spawns Crystals based on the amount of Shards picked up.
8 | 12 | 15 Shards Pickups
1 | 2 | 3 Crystals Spawned
On Class Ability Usage:
The next Stasis Weapon Kill spawns a Stasis Shard.

src.bungie:
The first time you break a target's shield or break the shield of a Guardian using their Super, you create an Orb of Power.

Collecting an Elemental pickup, collecting an Orb of Power, or destroying a Tangle grants you a small amount of health.

Upon first breaking a Combatant Shield, or a Supering Guardian's Shield:
Creates an Orb of Power that grants 7.15% Super Energy.
Performing a Finisher on a Combatant that didn't trigger the effect will also spawn an Orb of Power.
Upon picking up an Orb of Power, an Elemental Pickup, or destroying a Tangle:
Restores 40 HP.

src.bungie:
Finishers emit a damaging wave that matches the element of your currently equipped Super.

Arc, Void, and Stasis waves apply Blind, Weaken, and Slow respectively.
src.compendium:
Upon finishing a Combatant:
Triggers a wave, dealing 180 Super-Element Matching Damage up to 20 meters away.
Wave travels in the direction of the finisher and tracks enemies.
Wave damage ignores Power Delta, always dealing 180.
Equipping an Arc, Void, or Stasis Super makes the wave inflict a Super-Matching Elemental Debuff.
Arc = Blind
Void = Weaken
Stasis = Slow

src.bungie: Stunning a Champion grants maximum stacks of Bolt Charge. Damaging targets with Bolt Charge bolts jolts them and heals you.

Upon stunning a Champion:
Grants x10 Bolt Charge.
Bolt Discharge's Bolt Splash damage portion now inflicts Jolt.
Upon triggering a Bolt Discharge:
Restores ~55 HP.
Begins Critical Health regeneration
Does not begin recharging Shields.

Defeating [Arc]Arc debuffed targets grants Bolt Charge.

On Arc-Debuffed Enemy Kill:
Grants x1 Bolt Charge.
Upon scoring 3 Arc-Debuffed Enemy Kills within 6 seconds of each:
Spawns an Orb of Power that grants 7.15% Super Energy.
Restores 40 HP.

Stasis inflicts Freeze.

src.bungie: Granting allies an elemental buff gives class ability energy.
src.compendium:
Upon bestowing an Elemental Buff to allies:
~15?% Class Ability Energy.

src.bungie: Defeating targets has the chance to create an Elemental pickup matching your equipped Super element.
src.compendium:
Upon scoring a random, Pickup-based amount of kills:
Spawns a Super-Matching Elemental Pickup.
Kills needed to trigger vary per Elemental Pickup.
Firesprites, Void Breaches: 4–7 kills.
Ionic Trace, Stasis Shards, Tangles: 9–11 kills.
Triggers the global cooldown for Firesprites, Void Breaches, and Tangles.
Kills scored during the cooldown do not count for the next pickup.
Matching the Damage Type to the Super Element has no bonus effects.

src.bungie: Stunning a Champion with an elemental weapon creates an elementally aligned explosion, applying a matching elemental debuff to them and nearby targets.
src.compendium:
Upon stunning a Champion with an Elemental Weapon:
Triggers an Elemental-Matching Explosion that deals up to 315 Elemental Damage and inflicts an Elemental Debuff over 5 meters, down to 0% damage.
Arc: Jolt | Solar: Ignition | Void: Volatile
Stasis: Freeze | Strand: Sever
Has no effect on Kinetic Weapons.

src.bungie: [Arc]Arc weapon final blows have a chance to spawn an Arc Elemental Orb. Arc Orbs can be thrown or shot to create an Arc explosion that jolts targets it damages.
src.compendium:
Upon scoring 6 [2?] Arc Weapon Kills:
Spawns an Arc Elemental Orb.
Arc Elemental Orb:
Arc Orbs remain on the ground for up to 20 seconds before expiring.
Arc Orbs that are picked up can be held for up to 20 seconds.
Arc Orbs deal up to 405 [101] damage, down to 90% damage, and inflict Jolt over 8 meters.

src.bungie: Picking up an Elemental pickup or Tangle grants increased damage to weapons of the same element.
src.compendium:
Upon picking up a Elemental Pickup:
22% [?%] increased Pickup-Matching Weapon Damage for 7 seconds.
Displays as Weapon Surge despite stacking multiplicatively with it.

src.bungie: Rapid final blows with a Kinetic weapon or a weapon matching your equipped Super create an Elemental pickup that matches your equipped Super.
src.compendium:

Creates an Elemental Pickup that matches the equipped Super Ability's element.

Grants 5% [1%] Element-Matching Super Ability.

src.bungie:

src.compendium:
On Exhausted or Severed Enemy Kill with Super-Matching Weapons:
Grants 2?% Additional Super Ability Energy.

src.bungie: Sustained damage with micro-missiles causes the combatant to emit a Kinetic shockwave that damages nearby combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.

Target releases a Kinetic Shockwave that deals 120 [20] Kinetic Damage and stuns Unstoppable Champions over 7 meters.
Shockwave has no falloff.

35% -> 40% (3.7% increased damage)

 (25% of Magazine Size) + 1, rounded down

src.bungie: Casting your Solar Super grants nearby allies radiant and increases the damage of your Super for each nearby ally.

Caster and Allies within 15 meters are granted Radiant.

6% | ?% | ?% | ?% | ?% | 15?%

Solar Weapon Damage inflicts x30+15 Scorch to Combatants without Scorch stacks.

src.bungie:
Sustained damage with a Grenade Launcher increases the reload speed of Grenade Launchers and triggers a damaging Kinetic shockwave.

Releases a single Unstoppable-staggering Shockwave underneath the enemy.
Shockwave deals 227x2 = 454 Kinetic Damage over 7 meters.
Shockwaves from Primary and Special GLs only deal 150x2 Damage.
Shockwave has no damage falloff.
Incurs a 1 second cooldown upon triggering before hits count again.
Triggering Kinetic Impacts:
By scoring 3 non-simultaneous Power GL damage instances within 3 seconds of each.
By scoring a single non-lethal non-DoT Primary/Special GL damage instance.
By scoring a total of 5 DoT damage instances, counted up to once every 0.5 seconds.
-------------------------------------------
Upon dealing Grenade Launcher Damage:
Grants a stack of Rapid Impacts for 5 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
+5 | +10 | +15? | +20? | +30 Reload Speed
0.99x | 0.99x | 0.98x | 0.96x | 0.94x Duration Multiplier

src.bungie: Kinetic weapon damage against a powerful combatant has a chance to create a Kinetic Rupture. Targeting this Rupture causes a damaging explosion that staggers combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
src.compendium:
Upon scoring enough Kinetic Weapon Damage Instances against Elite+ Combatants:
Spawns a Kinetic Rupture for ? seconds which counts as a Weakspot.
Kinetic Ruptures can be damaged, activating after 0.3? seconds of being dealt damage, stunning Unstoppable Champions and dealing damage based on the amount of damage it received.
Kinetic Rupture Damage doesn't count as dealing damage to Combatants, uses PVP values for Damage Buffs, doesn't count as hitting nor missing either.
Eg: Radiant is 10%, Surges are 3% | 4.5% | 5.5%, Collective Action is 11%.
It's complicated, not worth on 99% of situations.
Tends to decrease damage by 25% to 50% on almost every situation.
One of the few meaningful exceptions is Izanagi x4
Izanagi x4 is +120% damage down baseline to +63% based on the buffs used.

src.bungie: Sustained Kinetic weapon damage and rapid final blows have a chance to generate a unique ammo brick. Collecting this brick will grant ammo to equipped Kinetic damage weapons and grant Special and Heavy ammo progress.
src.compendium:
Dealing Kinetic Weapon Damage and scoring Kinetic Weapon Kills progress a counter, spawning an unique Kinetic Ammo Brick upon reaching 100%.
Counter lasts 15s and is refreshed upon dealing Kinetic Weapon Damage.
Each damage point grants 0.0265% progress, requiring 3770 damage to spawn a brick.
A499 generates 75% less progress (15K damage for a brick).
RnF Kill = 8% | Elite = 15% | Miniboss = 25%
Damage requirement IGNORES Power-Delta, but considers ACTUAL DAMAGE DEALT.
This means it requires the same "base damage" regardless of reduced damage from PL deltas.
Upon collecting a Kinetic Ammo Brick:
+5% Special and +5% Heavy Ammo Progress.
Refills equipped Kinetic Damage Weapons and generates Special/Heavy Ammo for them.
Generates (1/3rd of Magazine) + 1 Ammo, with certain exceptions.
Counts for Ammo Pickup effects. Kinetic Ammo Generation is unaffected by Scavenger Bricks.
Bastion = +1 Ammo | Cull's Shadow = +2 Ammo | Praxic = +2 Ammo | Microcosm = +12 Ammo.

src.bungie: After throwing an Arc grenade, gain increased grenade recharge for a short time. Arc final blows extend the duration of this benefit.
src.compendium:
On Arc Grenade Ability Usage:
130% Additional Grenade Base Recharge Rate for 5 seconds.

+25 Void Overshield HP for 10+5 seconds.

85% [?%] increased Glaive Melee Damage for 6 seconds.

src.bungie: After picking up a [Void] Void Breach, dealing damage with a Void weapon creates a rain of seeking projectiles.

Weapon Surge x2 for 11 seconds.
